technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0
Implement HDFS write reliability using Spring Integration channels and commit tracking
Override partition function via custom module configuration in Spring XD streams
Support multiple topic-partition consumption using Kafka message bus consumer groups
Develop a new DSL parser for Flo UI that maintains context across stream definitions
Design single-container deployment using Spring Boot embedded server architecture
Handle ConfigurableConversionService tuples uniformly using serialization-aware converters
Benchmark streams with and without JMX using JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness)
assumptions: Developer has prior experience with Spring Framework and Spring XD
All necessary dependencies and build tools are pre-configured
Access to HDFS and Kafka clusters is available for testing
Existing test infrastructure can be reused for new features
Documentation will be written alongside implementation
Code reviews and integration testing are included in development effort

activities.activity_description: Experiment with removing the list of modules from BaseDefinition and reparse as needed, following the branch deploy-refactor-2
Implement reliable HDFS writes for stream pipelines with commit acknowledgments
Allow developers to override the partition function within source or processor modules
Enable consumption of multiple topic-partitions and serve data via a single queue

activities.activity_name: New DSL Parser for Flo UI
activities.activity_description: Develop a new DSL parser that detects incorrect module/option values and maintains context across stream definitions
Design and document the approach for deploying all modules within a stream in a single container
Handle non-default ConfigurableConversionService tuples uniformly to prevent reset after deserialization
Benchmark streams with and without JMX enabled and document performance differences
